```{r}
#| label: tbl-organism-resistance-rate
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# The version of the table the report renders, as for the infectious-agent
# table; see the marker of the same scope there. The engine's resistance
# table is named for the infectious agents on its rows; a dataset saved
# before the engine arrived carries it under the older name, and the older-
# name fallbacks stand as long as such a dataset can be rendered.
# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): never drop these fallbacks; a stored
# dataset outlives every release.
ia_slot <- if (identical(infectious_agent_rows, "ontology"))
  "infectious_agent_resistance_rate_ontology_table" else
  "infectious_agent_resistance_rate_table"
tbl_data <- reference_data[[ia_slot]]
if (is.null(tbl_data)) {
  ia_slot <- "infectious_agent_resistance_rate_table"
  tbl_data <- reference_data[[ia_slot]]
}
if (is.null(tbl_data)) {
  ia_slot <- "organism_resistance_rate_table"
  tbl_data <- reference_data[[ia_slot]]
}

# Rows keyed by node_id come from the classification engine; rows keyed by
# their printed label come from the taxonomy that preceded it.
ia_engine <- !is.null(tbl_data) && "node_id" %in% names(tbl_data)
ia_groups <- !identical(ia_slot, "infectious_agent_resistance_rate_ontology_table")

ia_node_id <- if (ia_engine) as.character(tbl_data$node_id) else character(0)
ia_summary <- if (ia_engine) ia_summary_rows(tbl_data) else
  rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
ia_bold <- if (ia_engine) {
  ia_summary |
    (ia_groups & tbl_data$level == 1 & !ia_summary) |
    (!ia_groups & tbl_data$rank %in%
       c("Domain", "Kingdom", "Realm", "Subkingdom", "Phylum",
         "Order", "Genus", "Group"))
} else {
  tbl_data$taxon %in% c("genus")
}
ia_italic <- if (ia_engine)
  tbl_data$rank %in% ia_italic_ranks else
  tbl_data$taxon %in% c("species")

if (!is.null(tbl_data) && nrow(tbl_data) > 0) {

tbl <- tbl_data |>
  dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
    ".ontology_path", "ia_tst_tot", "node_id", "parent_id", "rank",
    "quartile_departments", "total",
    "tested_n", "tested_total",
    # The resistance-test rate is an engine measure; a table from before the
    # engine keeps its earlier columns.
    if (ia_engine) character(0) else
      c("tested_pooled", "tested_ci_lower", "tested_ci_upper"))) ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # `gt::tab_stub_indent()` caps its per-level indent at five levels, so
    # the engine's deeper tree rows take their indent beyond the cap from
    # the label itself; see `ia_indent_labels()`.
    group = if (ia_engine) ia_indent_labels(group, level) else dplyr::if_else(
      stringr::str_detect(group, "spp."),
      paste0("*", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 1), "* spp.", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 2)),
      group
      )) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    !!sR$table_headers$count := "n",
    !!sR$table_headers$pooled := "pooled",
    !!sR$table_headers$q1 := "q1",
    !!sR$table_headers$q2 := "q2",
    !!sR$table_headers$q3 := "q3",
    !!sR$table_headers$tested := tidyselect::any_of(
      if (ia_engine) "tested_pooled" else character(0))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    abr = dplyr::recode_values(
      .data$abr,
      "3gcr" ~ "3gcr",
      "car" ~ sR$carbr_label,
      "cor" ~ sR$colr_label,
      "mrsa" ~ sR$mrsa_label,
      "vre" ~ sR$vre_label),
    level = .data$level + if (ia_engine) 0L else 2L) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$abr)

# The engine appends the tested columns after the quartiles; the Tested
# share is a measure of its own, so it stands between the count and the
# rate spanner rather than inside the spanner. The Partner Report places
# it at the same distance from the count.
if (sR$table_headers$tested %in% names(tbl))
  tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::relocate(
    tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$tested),
    .after = tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count))

cw <- compute_col_widths(tbl_data, stub_min = 34)

# The tested column's width comes out of the stub, as the per-agent table
# does for its infection-type columns. The stub's floor can absorb less
# than the column asks for, so the data columns share the shortfall in
# proportion and the declared widths keep their promise of 100%.
tested_w <- if (ia_engine && "tested_pooled" %in% names(tbl_data)) cw$q else 0
stub_w <- if (tested_w > 0) max(cw$stub - tested_w, 22) else cw$stub
data_scale <- if (tested_w > 0)
  (100 - stub_w - tested_w) / (100 - cw$stub) else 1

ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_inline

gt_tbl <- tbl |>
  gt(rowname_col = "group") |>
  sub_missing() |>
  gt::tab_options(
    latex.header_repeat = TRUE,
    latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = cw$font_size,
    footnotes.marks = "extended"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = !(tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count) | tidyselect::matches("^(group|level|taxon|abr)$")),
    decimals = 1,
    sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
    min_sep_threshold = 2,
    locale = locale_gt) |>
  fmt_integer(
    columns = tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count),
    sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
    min_sep_threshold = 2) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = "group",
  )

# Pooled rate CI merge
if (include_pooled_ci && "ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    cols_merge(
      columns = c(sR$table_headers$pooled, "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
      pattern = ci_pattern,
      rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled))
} else if ("ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = c("ci_lower", "ci_upper"))
}

# Resistance-test rate CI merge
if (sR$table_headers$tested %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`) &&
    all(c("tested_ci_lower", "tested_ci_upper") %in%
          colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`))) {
  if (include_pooled_ci) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$tested, "tested_ci_lower",
                    "tested_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$tested_pooled))
  } else {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_hide(columns = c("tested_ci_lower", "tested_ci_upper"))
  }
}

# Quartile bootstrap CI merge
if ("q1_ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  if (include_quartile_ci) {
    has_boot <- !is.na(gt_tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower"]])
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q1, "q1_ci_lower", "q1_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q2, "q2_ci_lower", "q2_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q3, "q3_ci_lower", "q3_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot)
  } else {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "q1_ci_lower", "q1_ci_upper",
      "q2_ci_lower", "q2_ci_upper",
      "q3_ci_lower", "q3_ci_upper")))
  }
}

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  cols_width(
    stub() ~ pct(stub_w),
    sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n * data_scale),
    sR$table_headers$pooled ~ pct(cw$pooled * data_scale),
    sR$table_headers$q1 ~ pct(cw$q * data_scale),
    sR$table_headers$q2 ~ pct(cw$q * data_scale),
    sR$table_headers$q3 ~ pct(cw$q * data_scale),
    tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$tested) ~ pct(tested_w))

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  gt::tab_stub_indent(
    rows = gt::everything(),
    indent = gt::from_column(column = "level")
  ) |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = gt::md(sR$`3gcr_label`),
    rows = abr == "3gcr"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      weight = "bold"
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      weight = "bold"
    ),
    locations = cells_stub(
      rows = ia_bold
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      style = "italic"
    ),
    locations = cells_stub(
      rows = ia_italic
    )
  ) |>
  cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("level","taxon"))) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$`rate_name`,
    columns = tidyselect::any_of(
     c(
     sR$table_headers$pooled,
     sR$table_headers$q1,
     sR$table_headers$q2,
     sR$table_headers$q3)),
    id = "organism_resistance_rate"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(
      cells_column_spanners(),
      cells_column_labels(),
      cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md(
      paste0(
        "$$\\text{",
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$rate_name_engine else
          sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$`rate_name`,
        "} = \\frac{\\text{",
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$rate_numerator_engine else
          sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$`rate_numerator`,
        "}}{\\text{",
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$rate_denominator_engine else
          sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$`rate_denominator`,
        "}} \\times ",
        format_integer(100),
        "$$"
      )),
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "organism_resistance_rate"),
    placement = "right"
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = interpolate_translation(
      if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$n_footnote_engine else
        sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$n_footnote,
      column = sR$table_headers$count),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$count),
    placement = "right") |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = interpolate_translation(
      if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$rate_footnote_engine else
        sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$pooled_footnote,
      column = sR$table_headers$pooled),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$pooled),
    placement = "right")

if (sR$table_headers$tested %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`))
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_footnote(
      footnote = interpolate_translation(
        sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$tested_pooled_footnote,
        column = sR$table_headers$tested),
      locations = cells_column_labels(
        columns = sR$table_headers$tested),
      placement = "right")

# Sparse-data footnote for N < sparse_threshold. The Tested share is flagged
# on its own denominator: a row may have few tested infections under a
# well-tested rate, or the reverse.
ia_rate_sparse <- !is.na(tbl_data$pooled) & tbl_data$n < sparse_threshold
ia_tested_sparse <- if (ia_engine && "tested_pooled" %in% names(tbl_data))
  !is.na(tbl_data$tested_pooled) &
    tbl_data$tested_total < sparse_threshold else
  rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
if (any(ia_rate_sparse, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(ia_tested_sparse, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  fn_text <- if (include_pooled_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci
  fn_text <- interpolate_translation(fn_text, threshold = sparse_threshold)
  sparse_locations <- list()
  if (any(ia_rate_sparse, na.rm = TRUE))
    sparse_locations <- c(sparse_locations, list(cells_body(
      columns = sR$table_headers$count, rows = ia_rate_sparse)))
  if (any(ia_tested_sparse, na.rm = TRUE))
    sparse_locations <- c(sparse_locations, list(cells_body(
      columns = tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$tested),
      rows = ia_tested_sparse)))
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_footnote(
      footnote = fn_text,
      locations = sparse_locations,
      placement = "right")
}

# Resistance category overlap source note
gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$resistance_overlap_footnote)

# The summary block counts the same infections as the groups, apart from
# them; it is a property of the engine's groups version.
if (ia_engine && ia_groups && any(ia_summary, na.rm = TRUE))
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$summary_block_note)

# n.o.s. definition source note
ia_residual <- if (ia_engine)
  !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("~n\\.o\\.s\\.$", ia_node_id) else
  tbl_data$taxon == "species_nos"
if (any(ia_residual, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$nos_footnote)
  if (ia_engine && any(ia_above_genus(tbl_data, ia_node_id, ia_residual),
                       na.rm = TRUE))
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$residual_above_genus_footnote)
}

gt_tbl
} else {
  cat(sR$`tbl-organism-resistance-rate`$no_data)
}
```
